loading_screen_tips: Hop a water taxi to cross the harbor fast.
Rowhouse stoops make great spots to catch your breath.
Gulls steal snacks. Keep your fries close.
Clear a district to lower its crime meter for good.
Pit stops on the harbor circuit save precious seconds.
Drones see more from above the rooftops.
Market stalls restock every in-game morning.
Fishing at dusk pulls in the rarest catches.
Talk to locals twice. Some have a second tip.
Cobblestones are slick in the rain. Brake early.
Night brings out the Phantoms. Carry a lantern.
Spend coins at the market for better gear.
The octagon crowd cheers louder for clean wins.
Row the inner harbor for hidden collectibles.
Check the map often. New spots open after bosses.
achievement_descriptions: Ride the water taxi to every stop.
Rest on ten different rowhouse stoops.
Finish a pit stop in under three seconds.
Fly a drone over every district.
Buy something from every market stall.
Catch a rare fish after sundown.
Send five Phantoms packing in one night.
Win the octagon without taking a hit.
Bring every crime meter down to zero.
Help every local with their errands.
Watch the end credits all the way through.
end_credit_lines: Thanks to every stoop sitter who waved.
Thanks to the gulls. We forgive you.
Cheers to the stall keepers, hon.
Big thanks to the water taxi crew.
Thanks to the pit crew for fast hands.
To the neighbors who lent us a lawn chair.
Thanks to the corner store for the snacks.
To the anglers who shared their spots.
Thanks to the octagon crowd for the noise.
And thanks to you for playing, hon.
crime_meter_clear_messages: District cleared. The stoops are safe again.
Crime meter zero. Neighbors wave you by.
All clear. Porch lights are back on.
This block is clean. Take a bow.
District secured. The corner store reopens.
Streets are quiet. Nice work out there.
Meter's empty. Kids are back outside.
Cleared! The whole block owes you a soda.
celebration_crowd_lines: Somebody get this one a parade!
You did it, hon! You really did!
Best day this harbor's ever had!
Honk if you love a clean street!
Ring the bells down at the pier!
Three cheers for the new champ!
Tell your mother, you're a legend!
Now that's how we do it here!
